subject: Re: CobaltAI - tri-region dedicated capacity ask and sizing
messages:
From: Jen Park <jen.park@cobaltai.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CobaltAI - tri-region dedicated capacity request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — CobaltAI is ready to move from pilot to a paid deployment and we need Redwood to propose a dedicated capacity plan that covers APAC and EU initially, with US as secondary (phase 2). High level asks below: 

- Target launch: Sept 15 (canary) -> GA Oct 1
- Traffic profile (attached): steady state ~110M tokens/day, peak 1.2k concurrent requests during US morning + APAC evening window (roughly 200 requests/s global); average response size ~350 tokens.
- Model: LlamaX-70B (we plan to use a quantized 4-bit runtime variant if that helps)
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 400ms for user-facing flows
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in EU; APAC in Singapore region
- Contract ask: 12 month committed reserved capacity with option to scale burst.

Can you send an initial sizing estimate (nodes / GPU types / burst buffer recommendation), high-level cost range, and timeline for provisioning? Procurement (contracts@procureops.com) is copied for SOW/terms.

I've attached the traffic_profile.csv — reach out if you need clarifications.

Thanks,
Jen Park
Head of Platform
CobaltAI

Attachments: CobaltAI_traffic_profile.csv (text/csv)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@cobaltai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, ProcureOps <contracts@procureops.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CobaltAI - tri-region dedicated capacity request

Hi Jen — thanks for the clear brief and the traffic file. Looping in Ben (capacity planning) and Lauren (finance/pricing) to get a first-pass estimate. A few quick clarifying questions to help sizing: 

1) Peak concurrency: is 1.2k concurrent requests the absolute sustained peak or a short spike (~5–10m)?
2) Are there any realtime batching constraints (i.e., do you need per-request single-turn latency vs batched throughput)?
3) Do you expect model version rollouts where both old/new variants run concurrently for ~2 weeks during canary?

Next steps: our plan is to run an internal sizing workshop today, produce a 1-page capacity proposal and a draft SOW for your legal team by EOD tomorrow (Aug 13).

Ben, Lauren — initial ask: tri-region footprint with APAC (Singapore) and EU (Ireland) as primary pools; US to follow in phase 2. Please see attached traffic file from Jen. I think we can make a cost-efficient plan using quantized runtimes + burst buffer on hosted nodes.

Jen — we'll include rough timelines for provisioning and a basic fallback strategy (hosted variant) if capacity needs spike during GA.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CobaltAI - tri-region dedicated capacity request

Stephanie / Lauren — quick internal sizing notes from the workshop: 

- Assumptions pulled from Jen's traffic file: 110M tokens/day, peak 200 rps global, avg response 350 tokens. With LlamaX-70B quantized to 4-bit we model ~3x throughput vs fp16 on our serving runtime for generation-heavy calls.

- Proposal (reserved pool baseline + burst):
  * APAC (Singapore): 6 x 80GB-A100-equivalent nodes (reserved) + 2 burst nodes on demand. This covers sustained peak with headroom for 20% growth.
  * EU (Ireland): 4 x 80GB-A100-equivalent nodes (reserved) + 1 burst node.
  * US: hold for phase 2; recommend 3 reserved nodes when we begin US onboarding.

- Rationale: APAC needs larger baseline due to customer distribution (APAC evening spike). EU steady-state lower but must satisfy data residency. The burst nodes can be pre-warmed for 10–15m to avoid cold-start latency and will serve as a buffer for traffic surges.

- Expected performance: 95p latency target (~350ms) looks achievable with our batching policy tuned for ~64 tokens/batch and KV cache prefixing.

- Estimated committed monthly cost (very rough):
  * APAC baseline: $86k–$110k/month
  * EU baseline: $58k–$75k/month
  * Burst / buffer: add-on $12k–$20k/month (pay-as-you-go)

- Risks / mitigation:
  * Model memory regressions: validate quantized runtime on a small canary node (we should run a perf verification job by Aug 20).
  * Procurement lead time: reserved node provisioning in new region typically takes 4–6 weeks; pushing the canary to Sept 15 is tight but achievable if contracts sign this week and we pre-reserve capacity.

I attached a quick estimate workbook (CobaltAI_capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx) with node-level math. If Lauren can sanity-check the ranges we can fold these into the SOW.

Ben
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CobaltAI_capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@cobaltai.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <contracts@procureops.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CobaltAI - tri-region dedicated capacity request

Jen — following up with an agreed first-pass proposal and next steps. Summary below and attached is a short SOW draft for procurement to review.

Summary of proposal:
- Baseline reserved pools: APAC (6 x 80GB-equivalent nodes), EU (4 x 80GB-equivalent nodes)
- Burst buffer: APAC +2, EU +1 as pay-as-you-go burst capacity
- Expected 95p latency: <= 400ms with quantized 4-bit runtime, batching and KV cache enabled
- Timeline: canary provisioning & perf verification targeted Aug 24–Sep 10; canary launch Sept 15; GA Oct 1 (contingent on signed SOW and finalized provisioning slots)
- Rough committed monthly range: APAC $86k–$110k, EU $58k–$75k, burst buffer $12k–$20k (exact pricing in SOW)

Next actions for CobaltAI:
1) Procurement: please confirm contract contact and any specific compliance clauses (e.g., data retention windows) — ProcureOps copied.
2) Engineering: confirm whether you want concurrent model rollouts (if yes, factor +1x capacity during rollout).
3) Legal/Procurement: review attached SOW draft (CobaltAI_SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf).

Ben / Lauren — confirm we lock the provisioning window this week if procurement signs. If we need to compress timeline, propose a phased approach: provision APAC first as canary, validate perf, then spin up EU.

Jen — happy to jump on a 30m call tomorrow to walk through details and the SOW.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: CobaltAI_SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf (application/pdf)
